episodes.211891: A broad upper level low centered offshore from northern California produced numerous thunderstorms in southern Oregon. One thunderstorm produced a lightning strike that burned a hole through the roof of a home.
episodes.211892: A broad upper level low centered offshore from northern California produced numerous thunderstorms in southern Oregon. One long-lived thunderstorm produced damaging winds across a portion of Jackson and Josephine counties.
episodes.212553: A slow moving storm system brought several days of showers and thunderstorms between the 2nd and 5th. Coverage was relatively sparse on the 2nd, then increased on the 3rd and 4th, with more isolated showers lingering through the 5th. The strongest storms formed on the afternoon of the 3rd, producing outflow gusts of 50-60 mph across the Reno-Carson City vicinity and eastward to parts of west central NV.
episodes.212725: An isolated severe storm moved over Chadron, NE, and produced strong winds gusts. A few other locations experienced gusty showers gusting between 50 and 58mph.
episodes.213509: Showers and thunderstorms developed over eastern Wyoming during the afternoon hours of May 3, producing localized severe wind gusts.
episodes.213925: A closed low-pressure system off the California coast brought strong winds and fast-moving thunderstorms to portions of Nevada. One storm produced severe winds.
episodes.214090: Isolated thunderstorms developed during the afternoon hours with one storm becoming severe that produced a severe wind gust in Fall River county.

events.narrative: Mesonet station NV025 Carson City measured a thunderstorm wind gust of 65 mph.
Mesonet station NEMNV 4.6 Gold Hill measured a thunderstorm wind gust of 58 mph.
WYDOT mesonet sensor 3 miles west of Van Tassell recorded a 58 mph wind gust as convective showers moved overhead.
KRNO measured a thunderstorm wind gust of 61 mph. Also, mesonet station NV013 Northwest Reno measured a thunderstorm wind gust of 60 mph.
ASOS station KCDR 5 miles west of Chadron gusted 60mph at 4:42 PM on May 3rd as a strong thunderstorm approached the terminal.
A thunderstorm in the city of Ashland produced  a lightning strike that burned a hole in the roof of a home.
Two mesonet sites on the Nevada National Security Site recorded severe winds from a thunderstorm 30 minutes apart.
A long-lived thunderstorm produced strong winds across the city of Gold Hill. Damage included multiple trees falling across roads and power lines, and a fallen tree that damaged a home.

A long-lived thunderstorm produced strong winds across the eastern portion of Grants Pass. Damage resulted from a tree falling on a parked pickup truck. Another fallen tree destroyed two mobile homes and injured two occupants.
